label: D2: arrived at S1 after previous trial was in S2 (state change to S1), early/mid episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and almost only when the state shown is S1 (98% of mass; 26% of D2-S1 steps are active, so D2&S1 alone has F1 0.41). Among S1 arrivals it fires when the previous trial ended in S2, i.e. a switch of the reached state to S1 (lift for prev_common rare, stay=0, prev_reward=0 follow from this). It is silent on S1 arrivals that follow a run of S1 trials (e.g. repeated a1->S1c rewarded). It also fades steadily over the episode: rate 9.7% in trials 0-9, near 0 after trial 80, so ep_trial<70 sharpens precision (dev P 0.75 R 0.64 F1 0.69 mass 0.75). Many misses are D2-S1 steps on the first trial of a window where prev_state is unknown; using prev_state != 1 raises dev mass recall to 0.90 (F1 0.67). It fires on both common (a1->S1) and rare (a2->S1) arrivals. Only observed variables are used. Not checked: what scales magnitude within active steps, beyond episode-time decay in firing rate.
